findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_request_status · Private data: get_guardian_context, get_place_info, fetch · Public sink: search_accommodations, get_request_status, create_lead, create_booking_request, request_charter, create_car_rental_request, create_trip_request · Destructive: edit_trip_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_request_status · Private data: get_guardian_context, get_place_info, fetch · Public sink: search_accommodations, get_request_status, create_lead, create_booking_request, request_charter, create_car_rental_request, create_trip_request · Destructive: edit_trip_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
